parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Simplify $\left(9p^{4}q^{-2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}} \times 2p^{-3}q^{5}$, giving your answer in positive index form.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Make $t$ the subject of the formula $v = \sqrt{\frac{k - 3t}{t}}$.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Solve the equation $\frac{4}{x - 1} + \frac{3}{x + 2} = 2$. Give your solutions correct to two decimal places.

syllabus_check: All four parts sit inside 4052: (a) a linear inequality with brackets on both sides (equations and inequalities); (b) laws of indices including a fractional index of a bracket and negative indices, answer in positive index form (indices); (c) changing the subject of a formula involving a square root and the subject appearing twice, needing factorisation of t (algebraic expressions and formulae); (d) a fractional equation that reduces to a quadratic, solved by the formula to two decimal places (equations and inequalities — quadratic by the formula). No calculus, surds beyond evaluating sqrt(97) on the calculator, logarithms or quadratic inequalities. Calculator allowed throughout as the rubric states; precision is stated only in (d) where 2 d.p. is wanted instead of the default 3 s.f.
originality_note: The exemplars are contextual quadratics (a trapezium area, Nadia's journey, a cuboid diagonal, a text-message mean). This question is the Paper 2 Q1 algebra-medley shape instead: four independent skills with no context. The inequality 5 - 3(x - 2) > 2x + 1, the index expression (9p^4 q^-2)^(1/2) x 2p^-3 q^5, the formula v = sqrt((k - 3t)/t) and the fractional equation 4/(x - 1) + 3/(x + 2) = 2 (reducing to 2x^2 - 5x - 9 = 0, discriminant 97) were all set from scratch and every answer derived and checked by substitution; none of the exemplars' numbers, unknowns, contexts or part sequences are reused.
